title: Beam-RemotePlus
tag_line: Drive with your phone: analog pedals, rich telemetry, dashboards, local multiplayer
message:
Companion mod of the Beam-RemotePlus Android app (successor of the official BeamNG remote control app).

Features:
- Automatic pairing on the local network (no QR code needed)
- Analog steering, throttle and brake
- Rich telemetry for phone dashboards (speed, RPM, gear, temperatures, warning lights, g-forces, tyre pressures...)
- Horn, high beams, hazards, indicators, lights, parking brake, starter, ESC mode, cruise control
- Vehicle switching, camera, gears and recovery from the phone
- Local multiplayer: one phone per player
- Translated in English and French

The mod is active as soon as it is enabled in the mod manager. Phone connections can be switched off with the "Enable Beam-RemotePlus" action (Options > Controls > General) or the Beam-RemotePlus UI app.

Android app and source code: https://github.com/LucienLassalle/Beam-RemotePlus-Mobile
